description: Defines the class 'prach_buffer_impl' which implements a PRACH buffer with fixed storage size, including methods for accessing buffer dimensions and retrieving symbol data, within the 'ocudu' namespace.

classes.name: prach_buffer_impl
classes.description: Implementation of a PRACH buffer with fixed size, providing accessors for buffer dimensions and symbol data retrieval.

methods.name: get_max_nof_ports
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of ports supported by the buffer.

methods.name: get_max_nof_td_occasions
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of time-domain occasions supported.

methods.name: get_max_nof_fd_occasions
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of frequency-domain occasions supported.

methods.name: get_max_nof_symbols
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of symbols supported.

methods.name: get_sequence_length
methods.description: Returns the sequence length (number of re).

methods.name: get_symbol
methods.description: Retrieves a span of cbf16_t representing a specific symbol at given port, td occasion, fd occasion, and symbol index.
